channel.title: The Dig — Spin qubit devices and figures of merit
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Spin qubit devices and figures of merit preset. Today's ranked reading list collects five relevance-3 skims at the application and tooling edge of quantum computing: 2611.08151 on an ML surrogate for hybrid quantum Monte Carlo, 2611.08220 on differential testing for quantum software stacks, 2611.09873 on trajectory-dependent decoherence and leakage in shuttled multi-spin qubits, 2611.09659 on an OpenQASM3-to-QuEST compiler and HPC-quantum offload model, and 2611.09779 on differentiable digital twins for calibration and characterization of neutral-atom and trapped-ion systems; together they inform workflow acceleration, compiler validation, scaling theory, HPC integration, and calibration methodology, though none directly addresses operation or benchmarking of the current static 16-qubit spin-qubit QPU.
